options.reason: The table was assembled to predict HER2 status from RNA-seq expression: label is a binary outcome (107 negatives, 15 positives) and all remaining columns are gene-level expression features, making this a binary classification task with rare positives. sample_id is a row key and never a feature; no column is derived from or recorded after the label, so there are no leakage suspects and no grouping or chronology columns.
options.title: binary
